app.title: zero-memory
app.description: Shared memory for coding agents — team dashboard
settings.providerKey.title: Your own provider key
settings.providerKey.description: Run this instance's model work on your own provider account instead of its key: extraction as you write, and the scheduled upkeep of your memories — hygiene, reflection and translation — which runs without you starting it. Your key is stored encrypted and is never shown again.
settings.providerKey.installed: A {provider} key ending {hint} is installed. All work on your memories runs on it, including scheduled passes, and no instance limit applies.
settings.providerKey.hint: Stored encrypted; it is never displayed or sent anywhere but your provider.
settings.deleteAccount.title: Delete account
settings.deleteAccount.description: Permanently erase your account and every memory, entity and connection you own. This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteAccount.warning: This permanently deletes your account and ALL records you own — every memory, entity, edge and link, plus your settings and sign-in. Memories others shared into your scopes are removed too. This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteAccount.exportHint: Want a copy of your data first?
settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage your memory data and workspace preferences.
settings.profile.title: Profile
settings.profile.description: How this account is named across the dashboard.
settings.profile.name: Display name
settings.profile.namePlaceholder: How you want to be shown
settings.profile.nameHint: Shown in the header and to people you share scopes with, in place of your email address. Leave it empty to fall back to the part before the @.
settings.export.title: Export memory
settings.export.description: Download all memory you can access as a Markdown tree — one file per memory, grouped by scope.
settings.export.hint: Exported memory is sensitive information — once downloaded, preventing leaks is your responsibility.
settings.import.title: Import memory
settings.import.description: Re-import an exported tree. Idempotent: re-dropping unchanged files is a no-op.
settings.import.dropHint: Drop the export .zip, Markdown files, or a folder here
review.title: Conflict review
review.description: Resolve the memory conflicts hygiene could not decide on its own.
review.scan.started: Scan started — refresh shortly to see new conflicts.
review.merge.title: Merge into one memory
rules.title: Rule candidates
rules.description: Memories that earned a place in your always-on rules — review the distilled drafts and apply the ones you approve.
rules.deliveredHint: General rules ride the MCP instructions on session start — capped, and dropped once past the delivery TTL. The rest stay promoted but undelivered until you revoke them or re-promote to reset the TTL.
rules.empty: No rule candidates yet. Facts that keep proving useful across sessions will show up here.
rules.targetHint.user: Paste into your personal CLAUDE.md (e.g. ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md) or download the file.
rules.targetHint.project: Paste into the project rules (e.g. .cursor/rules/ or the project CLAUDE.md) or download the file.
rules.revokeDialog.title: Revoke this rule
rules.revokeDialog.description: The rule leaves your active always-on layer. Remove it from your rules file yourself, then record why — the incubator will not propose it again.
rules.revokeDialog.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. superseded by a broader rule, no longer relevant, caused false positives…
rules.pinHint: Pinning guarantees this rule reaches every session it applies to: it is exempt from the delivery cap and the delivery TTL, and it leads the list a session receives — where the model's attention is warmest. Use it for the rules that must never be dropped as your rule set grows.
rules.pinnedCountHint: Pinned rules are delivered first and are never dropped by the delivery cap or TTL.
rules.addressHint: General rules load in every session; a rule about one project should be addressed to that project so it never leaks into unrelated sessions. Project-addressed rules arrive only in that project's briefings.
rules.deleteDialog.title: Delete this dismissed candidate?
rules.deleteDialog.description: The candidacy record is removed for good. The source memory stays; if it keeps proving useful, the incubator may propose it again.
rules.scan.started: Scan started — refresh shortly to see new candidates.
reflections.title: Reflections
reflections.description: Clusters of related episodes distilled into one living fact. Approving writes the consolidated memory; the source episodes stay and simply fade in ranking.
reflections.empty: No consolidation drafts yet. When several episodes tell one story, its distilled fact will show up here.
reflections.scan.started: Scan started — refresh shortly to see new drafts.
portability.title: Portability
portability.description: Project-scope facts the judge deems portable world knowledge, proposed for a move into your core scope. Approving re-scopes the memory so it follows you across projects; nothing moves without your decision.
portability.empty: No portability proposals yet. When a project memory turns out to be a portable world fact, its move to core will be proposed here.
portability.scan.started: Scan started — refresh shortly to see new proposals.
feed.title: Memories
memory.move.title: Move this memory to a project
memory.move.description: Pick the project scope this memory belongs to. Members of that scope will be able to recall it.
feed.filterHint: Applies filters and refreshes the feed
feed.empty: No memories visible for these filters.
feed.advanced.placeholder: Semantic search across your memories — Enter to search, Shift+Enter for a new line…
memory.sharedWith.title: Shared with
memory.sharedWith.description: Members of this scope can recall this memory.
entities.title: Entities
scopes.title: Scopes
scopes.export.label: Export
scopes.export.title: Export this scope as a Markdown .zip
scopes.export.confirmBody: This downloads the scope's memory as sensitive information. Once it leaves the database, preventing any leak is your responsibility.
scopes.empty: You are not a member of any shared scope yet.
scopes.create.hint: Allowed roots: project.* / proj.* / team.*. You become the first admin.
scopes.removeMember.confirmBody: {member} will lose access to this scope's memories. You can re-add them later.
scopes.controls.aliasPlaceholder: Short display name, e.g. Demo catalog
scopes.controls.renameHint: Only the last label changes; the owner prefix stays. All memories, entities and members follow the new name.
scopes.controls.mergeBody: Everything in this scope — memories, entities, members — moves into the target scope. This scope then disappears. Loss-free.
scopes.controls.deleteBody: Every memory in this scope will be permanently deleted, along with its entities, links and memberships. This cannot be undone. Consider merging into another scope instead.
auth.signUpDescription: Create an account to start sharing memory.
auth.signUp.confirmDescription: We sent a confirmation link to {email}.
auth.signUp.confirmHint: Open it to activate your account, then come back and sign in. If it is not there in a minute, check the spam folder.
auth.consent.template: I agree to the {terms} and have read the {privacy}.
auth.forgot.title: Reset your password
auth.forgot.description: We'll email you a link to set a new password.
auth.forgot.sentDescription: If an account exists for {email}, a link to set a new password is on its way.
auth.forgot.sentHint: Open it to choose a new password. If nothing arrives in a minute, check the spam folder — and that the address is the one you signed up with.
auth.reset.title: Set a new password
auth.reset.description: Enter a new password for your account.
auth.reset.noSession: This password-reset link is no longer valid. Request a new one.
auth.reset.noScript: This page needs JavaScript. Your mail client opened it in a restricted view — open the link in a browser window instead.
insights.title: Your impact
insights.description: What zero-memory did for you — captured, recalled, and saved.
insights.comparison.title: Compounding context
insights.comparison.description: Context that accrues across sessions instead of resetting each time.
insights.comparison.empty: Nothing captured in this window yet.
insights.chart.empty: No activity in this window yet.
insights.budget.label: Extraction budget
insights.budget.hintTrailing: Rolling {days}-day window — spend leaves the window as it ages
insights.digest.title: This week vs last
insights.briefingWarning: Briefings are coming back thin: only {hits} of {total} had context this period.
insights.metric.reinforcedHint: {num} of {den} surfaced facts kept coming back (usefulness proxy)
insights.metric.usefulnessHint: {num} of {den} surfaced facts were actually used
insights.tokensSaved.title: Tokens saved
insights.tokensSaved.help: Injected — context recalled from memory and fed into your sessions (what you didn't retype). Captured — facts written to memory for you. Both priced at the cost to regenerate them ({rate}/1M output tokens). Not the same as an LLM provider's input/output or cache read/write billing.
insights.tokensSaved.empty: No tokens saved in this window yet.
insights.metric.roiHint: {num} of {den} project questions a bare agent could not answer
insights.metric.roiRun: Ask your agent to run benchmark_memory to measure this
insights.metric.liveShareHint: {num} of {den} memories live — a balance, not a maximum
insights.metric.stalenessHint: {num} of {den} surfaced facts are older than 90 days
insights.metric.fadedHint: {num} of {den} live memories are past their kind's half-life — search ranks them at less than half strength
insights.metric.corpusAgeHint: median age of live memories — old facts fade in ranking, they are never deleted
insights.metric.precisionHint: {num} of {den} judged facts were relevant to the session
insights.metric.precisionConnect: Connect a watcher to see this — it judges relevance in the background while you work
insights.metric.emptyRecallsHint: {num} of {den} recalls surfaced nothing — coverage gaps to fill
insights.topFacts.title: Facts that fired most
insights.topFacts.empty: Nothing recalled yet in this window.
insights.empty: Once you start working with zero-memory, your impact shows up here.
activity.title: Memory activity
activity.description: Every recall run against your memory in the last 30 days.
activity.empty: No memory activity in this window yet.
